Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. It looks like the demo invite we attempted to send didn't land on your side (and some of the attendees reported a timezone mismatch), so I want to get us back on track quickly.

Apologies for the mess — was likely a calendar timezone flag combined with a stale join link. Can you confirm which of these windows work for your team (all times PT):

- Wed 18 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT — Technical deep-dive (recommended)
- Thu 19 Mar, 14:00–15:00 PT — Alternate slot (more overlap with EMEA)
- Fri 20 Mar, 08:30–09:00 PT — Short sync if you only need a quick demo

If you prefer, share 2–3 windows from your side and we will mirror. I’ve cc'd Karthik (solutions engineer) and Steph (AE manager) so they can prep. I’ll attach an updated calendar invite and a short mutual action plan after you confirm a slot.

Also, if anyone on your side didn't get the original invite, please let me know the email address that should receive the new one.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0198 | diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

Karthik — can you lead the technical deep-dive and prepare a short runbook covering:
- expected latency and throughput under 2/4/8 GPU configs
- data residency and privacy options for the demo assets
- whether we need to provide guest network access or a secure share for any datasets

Marissa — can you confirm your availability for Wed 10:00 PT to join for the first 30 minutes to cover commercial questions and next steps?

Oliver — regarding VPN/allowlist: we typically run live demos without requiring VPNs — we can host a temporary demo tenant and provide a time-limited join URL. If you prefer an on-prem snapshot we can discuss, but that will add prep time.

Next actions: I’ll send the calendar invite to the emails you listed, attach the MAP and the security questionnaire, and we’ll update the invite if anything changes.

Diego
